description: A Hash literal types as the bare, unparameterised .cls "Hash" -- this Ty language has no parameterised Hash type the way it has arrayOf for Array (see Ty.lean's module docstring); every hash literal gets the same generic class type regardless of its key/value shapes. This does not block *validating* the literal itself (no claim needed), only precise reasoning about what a later index on it returns (see hash-index-with-claim).
